channel.title: North Shore News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Shore News (nsnews.com)

item.title: Blueberry River First Nation school fire caused 'tremendous loss' to community
item.description: VICTORIA — Leaders of the Blueberry River First Nation in northeastern B.C. say the community has suffered a "tremendous loss" after a Saturday morning fire destroyed a local school, but they are also planning to rebuild it as soon as possible.

item.title: Metro Vancouver forecast: Foggy nights and mornings ahead
item.description: Metro Vancouver has been enjoying a sunny stretch for the last few days, and that's not exactly going to stop, but it will dim.

item.title: Thousands of fans celebrate life of legendary Grateful Dead guitarist Bob Weir in San Francisco
item.description: SAN FRANCISCO (AP) — Thousands of people gathered Saturday at San Francisco’s Civic Center to celebrate the life of Bob Weir, the legendary guitarist and founding member of the Grateful Dead who died last week at age 78 .

item.title: Dan David, Mohawk journalist and Indigenous news trailblazer, dies at 73
item.description: WINNIPEG — Dan David, a renowned Mohawk journalist and the founder of Aboriginal Peoples Television Network's news department, has died. His sister Marie David says he died last week after a long struggle with cancer. He was 73.

item.title: Ja Morant scores 24 points in return to lineup as Grizzlies beat Magic 126-109 in London
item.description: LONDON (AP) — Ja Morant had 24 points and 13 assists in his return to the lineup to lead the Memphis Grizzlies to a 126-109 victory over the Orlando Magic on Sunday in the first NBA regular-season game in London since 2019.

item.title: High-speed trains collide after one derails in southern Spain, killing at least 5 and injuring 25
item.description: MADRID (AP) — A high-speed train derailed in southern Spain on Sunday, jumping onto the track in the opposite direction and hitting an oncoming train, the Spanish rail operator Adif said.

item.title: Fire crews save house after explosion, fire in West Kelowna
item.description: VICTORIA — Firefighters in West Kelowna, B.C., say they managed to save a house from flames early Sunday morning following reports of an explosion.

item.title: Syrian government announces a ceasefire with the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces
item.description: RAQQA, Syria (AP) — The Syrian government Sunday announced a ceasefire with the Syrian Democratic Forces, taking almost full control of the country and dismantling the Kurdish-led forces that controlled the northeast for over a decade.

item.title: Chaos at Africa Cup of Nations final after Senegal players walk off field to protest penalty
item.description: RABAT, Morocco (AP) — The Africa Cup of Nations final has gone to extra time after finishing 0-0 in a chaotic end which saw Senegal players walk off the field when host Morocco was awarded a stoppage-time penalty.
